claims.statement: Two complete Apple M4 author-run cycles of the corrected same-algorithm M104 translated-port comparison reported Kotoba/C elapsed-time geometric means below 1.0.
claims.allowedUse: Technical history with exact host, revision, protocol and limitations.
claims.prohibitedUse: Kotoba is faster than C; official Embench score; independently verified result; result for all programs or hosts.
claims.comparator: pinned upstream Embench C built with the recorded Apple clang and flags on the same host
claims.correctnessGate: 19/19 exact result, fuel and arena accounting for Kotoba; 19/19 accepted C runs

claims.prohibitedUse: Any unqualified headline, advertisement, sales statement or benchmark summary.
claims.correctnessGate: not satisfiable as a universal claim

claims.statement: A named Kotoba execution profile denies undeclared authority and enforces declared resource bounds.
claims.allowedUse: Only for a named profile after executable positive and negative controls pass.
claims.prohibitedUse: Kotoba is safe; security certification; absence of vulnerabilities.
claims.workloadSet: named authority, admission, resource-limit and receipt tests
claims.comparator: declared expected allow/deny behavior, not C performance
claims.correctnessGate: all positive controls succeed and all undeclared-capability negative controls fail closed

claims.statement: A named Murakumo configuration is faster or more efficient than a named inference comparator on a specified workload.
claims.allowedUse: Only with exact model, quantization, runtime, host, concurrency, prompt/output lengths, metric, repetitions and comparator.
claims.prohibitedUse: Murakumo is faster than existing inference; using an inference result as proof of Kotoba language or Amu compiler speed.
claims.workloadSet: must be specified by the inference protocol
claims.comparator: must be same-host and same-model, or differences must be explicit
claims.correctnessGate: model outputs or accuracy threshold plus the inference protocol's validity checks
